discoveryCoverage: Five candidates identified in a coordinator reading of Ryan-named macOS Yarn nodes and bound to both builds. This is not exhaustive discovery, independent review or proof of runtime reachability. Other source families and route conditions need review; texture text is excluded by owner decision.

cases.observedSourceBehavior: An $isEditor-conditioned prompt asks whether Ryan was suggested to Conrad. Its two choices write opposite values to $suggested_ryan_to_conrad before the scene continues.
cases.invariant: Keep the condition, yes/no branch identities and opposite state writes exact; do not silently remove these source IDs or infer that the prompt is visible in a released build.
cases.adaptationRoute: Determine final source scope and runtime behavior before deciding whether these labels need a target representation. Preserve all program controls and investigate dependencies in the romance registry.
cases.nonTextDependencies: The $isEditor and $suggested_ryan_to_conrad variables and instructions are source controls; code-side initialization and other runtime mutations require separate confirmation.
acceptanceScenarios: Under a controlled editor-state probe, each choice must write the original corresponding boolean.
Reject any edit that swaps yes/no choices or rewrites the source control variable.

cases.observedSourceBehavior: Ryan carries a picnic basket in his mouth and several words are deliberately distorted; the player asks about his mouth and then agrees to open the gate.
cases.invariant: Keep the basket and full-mouth cause intelligible, consistently retain impaired speech including the final thanks, and preserve both sets of option identities.
cases.adaptationRoute: Prepare and review the entire exchange in Russian after the glossary gate; invent an intelligible speech effect rather than copying English spelling mechanically.
cases.nonTextDependencies: Basket, character pose and facial commands are relevant but have not been verified at runtime. The earlier editor-conditional flag prompt is separately registered as editor-route-prompt.
acceptanceScenarios: Exercise both opening replies and both gate replies, followed by the distorted thanks.
Reject text that makes the speech distortion unexplained or fails to convey the basket.

cases.observedSourceBehavior: In the seafood branch Ryan describes himself as a salmon guy and immediately corrects the human expression because he is a dragon; an alternative seafood response leads elsewhere.
cases.invariant: Keep the preference for salmon, the self-correction joke and the distinct alternative food branch without inventing a new dietary restriction.
cases.adaptationRoute: Adapt setup and self-correction together in idiomatic Russian, using the approved character glossary, before ordinary translation.
cases.nonTextDependencies: Date route, facial commands and option identities are recorded; runtime reachability and presentation remain unverified.
acceptanceScenarios: Select the meal branch and both responses to the seafood question.
Reject a setup that makes Ryan's dragon self-correction meaningless.

cases.observedSourceBehavior: The movie branch offers three distinct fictional titles; Ryan's follow-up differs for each and refers again to the Yip-Man series in one branch.
cases.invariant: Keep three distinct choices, their associated reactions and the title/series connection; preserve the source numeral 2 and the existing Yip concept.
cases.adaptationRoute: Consult the approved title and Yip glossary entries; review possible allusions and the full set of choices and reactions together before ordinary translation.
cases.nonTextDependencies: The titles overlap the Yip source case and the romance route registry; conditions, runtime layout and any further cultural references require review.
acceptanceScenarios: Choose each movie title and verify the corresponding reaction.
Reject a Yip-Man title inconsistent with its later series reference or a changed numeral.

cases.observedSourceBehavior: Two separate relationship paths refer to Conrad as tiny; one response on each path substitutes the same euphemism, with different follow-up reactions and alternative replies.
cases.invariant: Preserve the recurring euphemism and its relationship to Conrad's stature while keeping the two route contexts and option identities distinct.
cases.adaptationRoute: Decide a consistent Russian euphemism in both spans alongside the romance-route decisions and approved character terminology.
cases.nonTextDependencies: The spans lie under different route flags in the romance registry; three unrelated source values in the selected ranges differ in apostrophe spelling between builds. Runtime path selection remains unverified.
acceptanceScenarios: Exercise the euphemism and alternative reply in each of the two relationship paths.
Reject inconsistent euphemisms or a change that swaps route-specific reactions.
